description: Generate a video using Google's Veo 3. Returns an MP4 video file. Video generation takes 1-3 minutes — the tool will poll until complete. Veo 3 generates both video and ambient audio. Videos are saved to the shared directory and viewable in the browser viewer.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio — 16:9 for landscape, 9:16 for portrait/vertical

prompt.description: Text prompt describing the video to generate. Be descriptive about motion, camera angles, lighting, and scene details for best results.

name: generate_video
